title: Loss-Guided Pretraining Data Selection for Time-Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on heterogeneous collections containing billions of observations, yet their training windows are typically sampled without estimating whether they provide useful learning signal. We introduce a static data-selection framework that scores each window with a reference forecaster and retains an intermediate interval within every source dataset. Specifically, we connect forecasting loss to optimization difficulty by showing that normalized squared loss controls the per-sample gradient norm under a local Jacobian condition. We then define a reference loss score and apply dataset-stratified selection to preserve the diversity of samples. Across various TSFM architectures, our method outperforms random selection by an absolute margin and even improves both relative MASE and CRPS over full-data pretraining by retaining fewer candidate pretraining windows. translated_title: 面向时间序列基础模型的损失引导预训练数据选择
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在包含数十亿观测值的异构数据集合上进行预训练，然而其训练窗口通常是在未评估其是否提供有用学习信号的情况下采样的。我们引入了一种静态数据选择框架，该框架使用参考预测器为每个窗口评分，并在每个源数据集中保留一个中间区间的样本。具体而言，我们通过证明归一化平方损失在局部雅可比条件下控制每样本梯度范数，从而将预测损失与优化难度联系起来。随后，我们定义了参考损失分数，并应用数据集分层选择以保持样本的多样性。在各种TSFM架构上，我们的方法以明显优势超越随机选择，甚至在保留更少候选预训练窗口的情况下，在相对MASE和CRPS指标上超越全数据预训练。进一步分析显示出强大的跨……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出一种损失引导的静态数据选择框架，通过参考预测器评分筛选预训练窗口，从理论上证明归一化平方损失与优化难度相关，使得时间序列基础模型用更少的预训练数据就能超越全数据预训练的性能。
en_tdlr: A loss-guided static data-selection framework that scores pretraining windows with a reference forecaster and theoretically links normalized squared loss to optimization difficulty, enabling time-series foundation models to outperform full-data pretraining while retaining fewer candidate windows.
